{{Quote|You want an animal handler? Find a circus.|The [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''circus''' or '''carnival''' was a traveling entertainment show that displayed exotic animal [[Species/Legends|species]] from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], sometimes pitting them against each other in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] matches. Other creatures and beings performed tricks and acrobatic feats, all for the entertainment of the audience.

==History==
[[Circus Horrificus/Legends|Circus Horrificus]] was a well-known show in operation before, during and after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were famous for pitting fierce creatures against each other in matches to the [[Death/Legends|death]]. Prior to the Clone Wars, around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the circus was involved in the illegal [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] of [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]]. Later, when an [[arqet]] escaped and killed a dozen members of the audience, the scandal caused the operation to fade into relative obscurity and all but shut down completely. It was during this time that the [[Unidentified Circus Horrificus ringmaster|circus owner]] sold his [[Malakili/Legends|wrangler]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].

The [[Corusca Circus/Legends|Corusca Circus]] was a stationary circus located in the [[Old District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. All streets in that district led to the Corusca Circus which was distinguished from other parts of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] by its old-style yellowish lighting.

[[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]] was another traveling circus and rarity show, that specialized in capturing rare specimens of creatures, including [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] lifeforms, such as the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Greej]], and transporting them aboard a [[Starhunter menagerie ark]]. Owned by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Stroon]] and his assistant Mr. [[Slarm (Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie)|Slarm]], the Menagerie was put out of business by [[Jann Tosh]] after they had captured [[Ingey]], the pet of [[Coby]].

The [[Thranta Rider]]s, who were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings of an unknown species from an unknown world, tamed the [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and rode them, performing aerial shows across the galaxy. In lieu of costumes, the Riders preferred to paint themselves with complex patterns.

A popular event at a circus was for a rancor to hold a large log with a Twi'lek dancer on top. This was outlawed by the republic but still in common practice through out the outer rim.
